paper_title: Positional effects of fluorination in conjugated side chains on photovoltaic properties of donor-acceptor copolymers

knowledge_points.content: The researchers synthesized two donor-acceptor copolymers, PPh-m-F and PPh-o-F, by incorporating fluorine at the meta- or ortho-positions of the alkoxy-phenyl side chains on a benzodithiophene (BDT) unit, which was then copolymerized with difluoro-benzothiadiazole (2FBT) via Stille coupling.
knowledge_points.evidence: Benzodithiophene (BDT) derivatives with fluorine in the meta- or ortho-positions of the phenyl side chain were copolymerized with difluoro-benzothiadiazole (2FBT) (Scheme 1). ... The Stille coupling reaction was used to synthesize the two types of polymers.

knowledge_points.content: The PPh-m-F based organic solar cell achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 6.62%, with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.91 V, a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 11.25 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 64.6%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The device that used PPh-m-F yielded Jsc = 11.25 mAcm-2 FF = 64.6% Voc = 0.91 V and PCE = 6.62%.

knowledge_points.content: Fluorination at the ortho-position of the phenyl side chain (PPh-o-F) results in a deeper HOMO level (-5.70 eV) compared to meta-fluorination (PPh-m-F, -5.56 eV) because the fluorine atom is closer to the polymer backbone, enhancing the inductive effect through sigma bonds.
knowledge_points.evidence: The HOMO energy levels were found to be -5.56 eV in PPh-m-F and -5.70 eV in PPh-o-F... The inductive effect depends critically on the distance between groups through σ bonds, so PPh-o-F may display a lower HOMO level in the CV results than PPh-m-F.

knowledge_points.content: PPh-m-F exhibits a smaller pi-pi stacking distance of 0.38 nm compared to 0.46 nm for PPh-o-F, indicating that meta-fluorination allows for a more planar backbone and closer intermolecular packing.
knowledge_points.evidence: The π-π stacking distance was shorter in PPh-m-F (0.38 nm) than in PPh-o-F (0.46 nm). This difference indicated that the chain of PPh-m-F was more planar and was packed closely along the π-π direction.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations (B3LYP/6-31G) revealed that PPh-o-F has a larger backbone dihedral angle (25.2°) and a larger side-chain-to-backbone torsional angle (62.1°) than PPh-m-F (21.5° and 56.7°, respectively) due to steric hindrance from the ortho-fluorine atom.
knowledge_points.evidence: The dihedral angle θa in the backbone bridge joint... was 21.5° in the PPh-m-F model but 25.2° in PPh-o-F... The dihedral angles θb calculated between the plane of the phenyl side chain and the plane of the BDT was 56.7° in PPh-m-F and 62.1° in PPh-o-F.

knowledge_points.content: UV-Vis absorption spectra of PPh-m-F in solution show a pronounced shoulder at long wavelengths, which is absent in PPh-o-F, indicating stronger aggregation and polymer interactions in the meta-substituted derivative.
knowledge_points.evidence: The solution spectra of PPh-m-F revealed a pronounced shoulder at long wavelengths as a result of strong aggregation related to polymer interactions... PPh-o-F showed good solubility and no shoulder peaks in the solution state.

knowledge_points.content: PPh-o-F devices exhibit a higher Voc (0.96 V) than PPh-m-F (0.91 V), but significantly lower Jsc (4.31 mA cm⁻²) and PCE (2.51%), primarily due to reduced chain rigidity and inferior crystalline ordering.
knowledge_points.evidence: PPh-o-F displayed inferior electrical characteristics (Jsc = 4.31 mA cm-2 FF = 60.6% Voc = 0.96 V and PCE = 2.51%)... whereas the substitution of fluorine at the ortho-position reduced the chain rigidity and caused inferior crystalline ordering.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized device architecture used for the polymer:PC71BM solar cells was a conventional structure: ITO/MoO3/Active Layer/LiF/Al, with 1.5 vol% of 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) used as a solvent additive in 1,2-dichlorobenzene (DCB).
knowledge_points.evidence: photovoltaic characteristics... were evaluated by fabricating conventional cells [ITO/MoO3/polymer:PC71BM/LiF/Al]... optimized by using 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as a solvent additive... 1.5 vol% in DCB.

knowledge_points.content: The hole mobility of PPh-m-F was measured to be 1.13 x 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, which is nearly double that of PPh-o-F (5.64 x 10⁻⁵ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹), as determined by space-charge-limited current (SCLC) measurements.
knowledge_points.evidence: the hole mobility in PPh-m-F was higher than that in PPh-o-F (Table 2). ... PPh-m-F: 1.13 x 10-4, PPh-o-F: 5.64 x 10-5.

knowledge_points.content: 2D grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (2D GIXD) analysis revealed that PPh-m-F films possess a more distinct crystalline feature with edge-on crystallites oriented predominantly in the out-of-plane direction compared to PPh-o-F.
knowledge_points.evidence: The substitution of the fluorine atoms... at the meta-position... yielded a more distinct crystalline feature... with edge-on crystallites oriented predominantly along the out-of-plane direction.

knowledge_points.content: The lower Jsc in PPh-o-F devices compared to PPh-m-F is attributed to a combination of a lower absorption coefficient across the UV-Vis range and a reduced ability to form interconnected crystalline grains.
knowledge_points.evidence: PPh-o-F had a lower absorption coefficient than did PPh-m-F over the entire UV-Vis range... PPh-m-F included reinforced intermolecular interactions that increased the number of interconnected crystalline grains.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgap (Eopt) of PPh-m-F is 1.77 eV, while PPh-o-F has a wider bandgap of 1.83 eV, reflecting the differences in backbone planarity and effective conjugation length.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optical band gaps of PPh-m-F and PPh-o-F were 1.77 eV and 1.83 eV respectively (Table 1). Variations in the band edges were attributed to the backbone planarity.
